title: BlackLanturn 1.1.32
summary: Lower update memory use, safer recovery and faster return to lower browsing rows.

sections.heading: Lighter, protected updates
bullets: Update files are processed in small chunks, reducing memory pressure on Fire Stick.
Kodi pauses new background row requests and automatic previews while updating. Keep Kodi open until the update finishes.
An interrupted update recovers the previous complete add-ons and patches before retrying.

sections.heading: Faster lower-row browsing
bullets: More small rows can be reused within the same cache byte limit, reducing repeated loading as you browse deeper.
Recommendation freshness and watched-status refreshes remain active.

sections.heading: Your complete setup stays saved
bullets: Update BlackLanturn keeps your accounts, settings, sources, favourites, watched progress and other installed add-ons.
Both approved icon packs remain included. Personal Fight Zone remains outside the public packages.
